structured_output.what_is_happening: A token called "Cream", 11 minutes old, is pumping (+160% in 1h, +54% in 5m, $169k volume on a $137k market cap). Its linked "twitter" is a status URL from the cremieuxrecueil (Cremieux) X account, so it is a tweet-derived meme launch. At least 10 other "Cream" tokens were launched within about 12 minutes of each other. Several are bigger than this one: 66Rv at $533k, Do4V at $274k with $962k hourly volume, DAFB at $224k. This one is a mid-pack copy, not the leader.

narrative.description: A tweet-meme from a prominent X personality (Cremieux) set off a rush of 'Cream' launches. The story is a one-tweet meme with no project behind it.
narrative.why_spreading: Deployers race to tokenize a viral tweet or post from a large account. Buyers split across many same-name contracts within minutes.
